name: memory-vault
description: Personal agent memory vault plugin for durable cross-task knowledge, preferences, workflows, and AGENTS.md memory rules.

interface.shortDescription: Create and maintain a personal agent memory vault with durable notes and category indexes.
interface.longDescription: Provides a passive skill for initializing, reading, and maintaining a personal agent memory vault for cross-task user preferences, decisions, environment facts, workflows, terminology, unresolved questions, 1-2 level category INDEX.md files, and bounded AGENTS.md memory rules.
defaultPrompt: Remember this preference for future agent work.
Initialize my personal memory vault at ~/Workspace/Memory-vault.
Use the memory vault when I mention long-term notes, user preferences, or durable agent memory.
Add Agents/Prompting as a memory vault category and update the root AGENTS.md category map.
